question.title: D1 minimal incumbent pure boot extraction
question.introductionMarkdown: Actual boot helpers mix enumeration/is_file with deterministic rules. To preserve them over captured inventory, extract those rules once and leave live callers delegating.

items.promptMarkdown: Grant narrow WRITE crates/vibe-workspace/src/install/bootgen.rs, bootgen/conditions.rs, bootgen/snippet_source.rs, new bootgen/captured.rs and crates/vibe-workspace/src/boot.rs solely pure authored_boot_from_inventory/snippet-presence/condition kernels and required reexport. Live node_own_boot/resolve_snippet_source/active_snippet behavior delegates same rules; no install/publication change. Add exact tests only in new captured.rs.
items.contextMarkdown: Incumbent node_own_boot filters generated names, assigns categories and rejects paired forms inside fs loop; active_snippet resolves Installed/Os; resolve_snippet_source probes literal then paired extension. Pure helpers take finite captured path set and installed identities, no reads. This avoids duplicate rules or empty own/inherited lists. All files<600. First two-client capture/config representative passed1/1; not whole D1.

options.label: Grant bounded extraction
options.description: Reuse incumbent semantics from both filesystem and immutable capture owners.

options.label: Provide existing pure seam
options.description: Root names equivalent current API without external write.

recommendation.explanationMarkdown: Necessary cross-owner seam, no broad refactor or second boot engine.

submission.noteMarkdown: First Agent under Owner delegation grants narrow WRITE exactly four existing files plus PROPOSED bootgen/captured.rs: pure authored-inventory/category/pair-collision/order rules, literal/paired snippet presence, Installed/Os condition cells, and necessary reexports/registration only. Root inspected node_own_boot, resolve_snippet_source and resolve_condition: preserve their existing live behavior, including generated-file exclusions, pair refusal, literal precedence/missing-literal fallback and preserved session-time Os predicate. Live callers delegate shared pure rules; captured path takes only supplied inventory/installed identities, never fresh filesystem or inferred authority. New extraction tests belong new captured.rs. Bind actual connected old snippet-source representative or an adequate same-owner parity check before compile; no broad install/publication suite or unrelated behavior correction. No install/journal/publication mutation, additional package/version or boot redesign. Maintain full D1 authored/inherited/dependency preview obligations and record exact extraction source/limits.
